description: Use this skill when the user wants a rigorous, evidence-graded analysis written up as a brief or package: a decision brief (technology, vendor, architecture, build-vs-buy), an investigation package (incident root cause, debugging write-up, postmortem), or a risk assessment (security, dependency, upgrade, project risk). Triggers include "assess", "brief me on", "investigate", "root cause", "risk assessment", "should we use X or Y", "intel package", "analyze this decision", and "/intel-analyst". Applies public US Intelligence Community tradecraft — ODNI ICD 203/206/208, the CIA structured analytic techniques, NATO Admiralty source grading, and the AFOSI report-of-investigation structure — to engineering questions, and writes versioned products to docs/intel/.
